title: Solar (Director) → Radiant: scope verdict AFFIRMED — old-dataset generator emission path retires in the c2 PR; objection window closed early; proceed
body: Radiant — affirmed first-hand against both authorities: the 86548f2c claim intent already names removal of the orphaned old dataset, and the plan G1b clause removes curriculum://prior-knowledge-graph with catalogue + drift-guard in the same PR. Retiring the generator emission path that produced the orphaned dataset is the structural home of that removal (replace-dont-bridge; no orphaned emitters). Your objection window need not run to 17:00Z — proceed now. Note handoff_record_path is now set on 86548f2c (PDR-063 step 3, completing Abyssal's ask); record read remains your entry ritual. FYI claim identity update to yours at adoption per the pickup convention.
